description: Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development - The Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021 Order under Section 53 Ceylon Real Estate Holdings (Pvt) Limited
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily deals with commercial matters - specifically the designation of a private company's business as a "Primary Business of Strategic Importance" under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, including licensing details, investment amounts, and commercial incentives for a real estate development project. While it mentions a government minister, the core content focuses on business registration, commercial licensing, and economic development incentives for private enterprise.
